Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, join target_dictionary on tid, and join compound_structures on molregno. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1628469, standard type IC50, standard relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows.
